warnings.message: Copilot names models differently in the CLI and VS Code, so @examples/code-reviewer's `strong` hint was left out; set targets.copilot.overrides.model to choose one.
Copilot's agents can't preload skills in both the CLI and VS Code, so @examples/code-reviewer's skills are installed but not preloaded; the agent finds them as any other skill.
@examples/format-on-edit's command uses an $RMK_ variable; Copilot passes the event as JSON on stdin instead, so the hook has to read it from there.
Skills don't take arguments, so @examples/review-diff's placeholders stay in its text, with a note saying what each one is.
GitHub Copilot has no allow or deny list a project or the home folder can hold, so @examples/safe-git was skipped there.
